display.description:
Aims to replicate the nuanced extraction characteristics of traditional manual lever espresso machines. Opening the lever valve initiates a quick pre-infusion phase at low pressure, allowing the steam pressure in the boiler to evenly saturate the puck. After 10 seconds of pressure equilibrium, the pressure ramps up to the set 'Target Pressure' and then gradually declines. 

Dial in a flow rate of 1.2 to 1.8 ml/s during extraction, with only a few drops in the cup during pre-infusion and blooming.

display.description:
Immediately ramps-up to high pressure, bypassing the traditional pre-infusion phase. This rapid increase in pressure quickly saturates the coffee puck and initiates the extraction process almost instantly.

Studies have shown that this method enhances sweetness and clarity, providing a bright and bold extraction.

Often preserves the acidity despite the long extraction ratio.

Dial in a flow rate of 2.0 to 4.0 ml/s during the extraction. Use the 'Flow Limit' Variable to prevent absolute gushers.
